boards.school_name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten documented destinations on Franklin Street and its immediately adjacent downtown corridors, each with a specific reason to stop.

cards.title: Ackland Art Museum
cards.subtitle: South Columbia Street, beside West Franklin Street
cards.notes: Enter from South Columbia Street and use the gallery map to choose an exhibition or collection area before you start looking around.
cards.short_summary: A free UNC art museum steps south of Franklin Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ackland Art Museum is at 101 S. Columbia Street near West Franklin Street, and admission is always free.
cards.access_notes: Open Wed–Sat and Sun; confirm holiday closures and current gallery access before going.

cards.title: Morehead Planetarium and Science Center
cards.subtitle: East Franklin Street corridor
cards.notes: Check the day’s planetarium-show listings, then allow time to explore the science-center offerings around your scheduled program.
cards.short_summary: A UNC science center at 250 E. Franklin Street with planetarium programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Morehead Planetarium and Science Center is located at 250 E. Franklin Street on UNC-Chapel Hill’s campus and lists planetarium shows.
cards.access_notes: Programs and ticket requirements vary; consult the current event listing before arrival.

cards.entity_name: Joan H. Gillings ArtSpace at CURRENT
cards.title: Joan H. Gillings ArtSpace at CURRENT
cards.subtitle: West Franklin Street corridor
cards.notes: Look at Carolina Performing Arts’ calendar first and plan around a listed performance, installation, or event at the Franklin Street venue.
cards.short_summary: Carolina Performing Arts’ immersive and interdisciplinary-art hub on Franklin Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Joan H. Gillings ArtSpace at CURRENT and CURRENT Studio are at 123 W. Franklin Street and serve as Carolina Performing Arts’ hub for immersive and interdisciplinary art.
cards.access_notes: Dates, times, and admission depend on the individual performance or event.

cards.title: Varsity Theatre
cards.subtitle: East Franklin Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the theatre’s current schedule to select a film and verify its rating and start time before heading to 123 East Franklin.
cards.short_summary: A movie theatre at 123 E. Franklin Street with a current public schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Varsity Theatre’s schedule lists film showtimes, and the Town identifies the theatre at 123 E. Franklin Street.
cards.access_notes: Showtimes and film ratings change; confirm the current schedule and age appropriateness before purchasing.

cards.title: Epilogue Books Chocolate Brews
cards.subtitle: East Franklin Street corridor
cards.notes: Browse the independent-bookstore shelves, then check the venue calendar for an all-ages-appropriate reading, conversation, or music event.
cards.short_summary: An independent bookstore and chocolatería at 109 E. Franklin Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Epilogue Books Chocolate Brews is an independent bookstore and Spanish-style chocolatería at 109 E. Franklin Street.
cards.access_notes: Retail and food purchases are optional; review event details for any age or ticket requirements.

cards.title: Carolina Coffee Shop
cards.subtitle: East Franklin Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the Franklin Street address to find the storefront, then choose from the posted food, coffee, and tea offerings during service hours.
cards.short_summary: A sit-down restaurant and café at 138 E. Franklin Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Carolina Coffee Shop is at 138 E. Franklin Street and offers food along with coffee and tea.
cards.source_title: Coffee Shops in Chapel Hill and Orange County
cards.access_notes: A purchase is required for food or drinks; verify current hours directly with the business.

cards.title: Sutton's Drug Store
cards.subtitle: East Franklin Street corridor
cards.notes: Stop at the 159 East Franklin storefront to see the historic site, then review the current menu and service details before ordering.
cards.short_summary: A long-running Franklin Street restaurant documented at 159 E. Franklin Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chapel Hill Historical Society identifies Sutton’s at 159 E. Franklin Street; the official tourism authority describes it as a Chapel Hill tradition since 1923.
cards.access_notes: Food purchases are optional; check current operating information before visiting.

cards.title: Peace & Justice Plaza
cards.subtitle: East Franklin Street corridor
cards.notes: Pause at 179 East Franklin Street to read the site context, then continue along the downtown corridor with its civil-rights history in view.
cards.short_summary: A downtown plaza connected to Chapel Hill civil-rights movements.
cards.evidence_claim: Peace & Justice Plaza at 179 E. Franklin Street is identified as a site of civil-rights movements beginning in the 1960s.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public-space access may be affected by scheduled events or temporary Town operations.

cards.title: Greetings from Chapel Hill mural
cards.subtitle: Rosemary Street, immediately behind West Franklin Street
cards.notes: Walk around to the Rosemary Street side behind He’s Not Here and photograph the mural from the public right-of-way without blocking access.
cards.short_summary: A 1941-postcard-inspired mural on the Rosemary Street side of West Franklin.
cards.evidence_claim: The “Greetings from Chapel Hill” mural is on the back side of He’s Not Here at 112½ W. Franklin Street, along Rosemary Street.
cards.source_title: 17 Must-See Murals in Chapel Hill and Orange County
cards.access_notes: View from public areas and respect adjacent businesses and private-property boundaries.

cards.title: Chapel Hill/Orange County Welcome Center
cards.subtitle: West Franklin Street corridor
cards.notes: Pick up a downtown walking map or ask staff for current public information before continuing along Franklin Street and nearby corridors.
cards.short_summary: The county tourism authority’s information center at 308 W. Franklin Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chapel Hill/Orange County Visitors Bureau Welcome Center is located at 308 W. Franklin Street and lists public visitor hours.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Mon–Fri 8:30 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sat 10 a.m.–3 p.m.; confirm before visiting.
